response.evidence_available: User A accessed GET /api/orders/5001 and received a 200 OK response containing order details. The endpoint uses a predictable, sequential numeric identifier (5001).
response.evidence_missing: There is no evidence establishing ownership of order 5001, whether User A is authorized to view it, or if User A can access orders belonging to other users (IDOR/BOLA).
response.safe_verification_procedure: In an isolated test environment, register two distinct non-privileged users: User A and User B. Create an order belonging to User B (e.g., ID 9001). Authenticate as User A and send a GET request to /api/orders/9001. If User A successfully retrieves User B's order details, a vulnerability exists.
